page.layout: One title page: a single block of centred lines. Hebrew line at the very top, then the title in large capitals and italics, the imprint at the foot. No margin text. Stamps, shelf labels and handwriting are not transcribed.

main_text.l: SS. Theol. Doct. & P.P. h. t. Facult. Decani,
Ad d. 11. Novembr, M. DC. XCI[?].

page.notes: The top Hebrew line is too faint to read reliably, so it is marked illegible; it is likely a Hebrew motto. The date "XCI" is partly obscured by a library stamp and is marked [?]. The Greek title is printed in Greek capitals with its final sigma as Σ. Excluded as not printed text: the library stamps (Staatsbibliothek München), the yellow shelf label "Diss. 4° 3171 17", and the handwriting at the top left and top right.
